source.execution_revision: Resolve to reviewed merged main after prerequisite instrumentation/contract fixes; freeze the same clean producer across all stages. A later numerical change supersedes affected comparisons.

roster_policy: All five systems execute every declared arm/pack/regime/seed. Previous engine-only and interrupted-slot exceptions apply only to the completed historical run. No silent exclusions, pooled duplicate controls or selective successful-only reporting.

controls.independent_runs: Fresh weights/search/archive per slot; no cross-run inheritance.
controls.order: Rotate arm and five-system order across seeds; reverse on alternate budget/compute regimes. Pair all arms for each seed before moving on. One fit worker at a time; record host load, active time and sleep events.

baselines.policy: Relevant named optional models must actually execute and succeed; missing packages or skipped required experiment baselines block their stage. Preserve required-floor, named-neural/boosted and full-pool outcomes separately. Full-pool best is secondary. No retuning after start.

stages.purpose: Qualify exact producer, profile both budgets and prove clean pause/resume without score-based tuning.
stages.gate: All systems, exports and winner replays pass; timers reconciled; graceful-stop acceptance passes.

stages.purpose: Qualify four language tasks and enhanced contender execution before broad confirmation.
stages.gate: No missing engine/task or required baseline; checksum-pinned datasets, causal inputs and adequate baselines verified. Runtime success alone does not establish baseline adequacy.

stages.purpose: Six-seed exploratory screening of Prism policy components and six controlled Stratograph questions.
stages.gate: Q-core passes; all arms frozen and all 330 slots run. No confirmatory claims from this screening.

stages.purpose: Independent twelve-seed confirmation of nominated policies and current contender floors.
stages.gate: Nomination receipt is frozen before generating or inspecting these data/seeds; exact selected policies materialized and validated.

stages.purpose: Compare quality under shared measured-training ceilings, with exact consumed work, cap-limited runs and censored outcomes visible.
stages.gate: New versioned compute-budget runner/export contract and all five executors must pass acceptance first. Current CampaignSpec timeout is not this budget.

stages.purpose: Fresh-seed longer-context and second-corpus robustness, plus a separate delayed-memory diagnostic.
stages.gate: Q-breadth and B-confirmation pass; policy nomination already locked. No tuning on these outcomes.

nomination.scope: Provisional candidate selection, never a promotion claim.
rules: Evaluate all six seed pairs and all four tasks, with failure/coverage information. Do not read B/C/D outcomes during nomination.

Prism nomination uses legacy as the image/regression guard reference and current open as the language reference. Eligible candidate: mean digits accuracy no more than 0.25 percentage points below legacy; mean MSE no more than 2% above legacy; mean LM perplexity no more than 1% above current open. These screening guards are practical filters, not noninferiority proofs.

Stratograph eligible candidate: mean accuracy on either classification task no more than 0.25 percentage points below current trainable/open reference; mean MSE and LM perplexity no more than 2% above that reference.

Among eligible candidates select the greatest equal-weight direction-aware symmetric quality effect against current reference over digits, diabetes and Shakespeare. If effects differ by less than 0.01, prefer lower summed measured fit-training seconds; remaining tie uses fewer serialized winner bytes, then lexical arm ID. Retain current reference when no candidate qualifies. No task-specific hybrids or newly invented policies.
The selected bundle combines only nominated Prism and Stratograph policies; Topograph open, Primordia breadth_v2 and the contender pool remain unchanged.

Freeze exact full selected policy objects and hashes before confirmation. If both nominations equal the reference, omit the entire redundant selected-bundle arm from B/C/D by this predeclared rule, record the reduced roster of arms, and still run all five systems for every retained combination.
nomination.never_do: Do not substitute reference configs for unresolved selected-bundle templates; do not relabel screening seeds as confirmation.

statistics.unit: Matched seed, never individual fits or repeated unchanged-engine control runs.
statistics.bootstrap: 4096 deterministic paired-seed resamples (RNG 0), 95% percentile intervals; retain all raw metric pairs.
statistics.effect: Direction-aware symmetric relative effects and equal task weights; report classification changes in percentage points and regression/LM changes in raw units and ordinary relative percentages as well.
statistics.screening: A has six seeds and ten declared mechanism contrasts; descriptive screening only. Even unanimous six-seed signed-rank results cannot generally pass correction across ten tests. No significant-gain label is authorized.
statistics.confirmation: B has twelve independent fresh paired seeds. Predeclare six primary panels at 128: two nominated-vs-reference policy aggregates (Prism, Stratograph) plus four selected-bundle engines vs required contender floor. If selected bundle was omitted, policy panels are unavailable, and floor panels use reference. Keep the six-panel family for Holm correction.
statistics.compute: C has twelve seed pairs and twelve primary panels: at each of two caps, two selected-vs-reference policy contrasts plus four engine-vs-required-floor contrasts. Missing/cap-inadequate floors make their panels unavailable, never substitute another baseline. Holm across the twelve-panel family.
statistics.breadth: D has six primary panels: two policy contrasts plus four engine-vs-floor contrasts, using the two real-text breadth tasks (Shakespeare context64 and Aesop context64). Original Shakespeare is a bridge task; delayed-copy is a separate diagnostic. Do not let synthetic-memory gains mask real-text regressions. Holm across the six-panel family.
statistics.ceilings: Remove a task from a contrast aggregate only if every paired observation in both arms is at its known ceiling; retain raw task results. Banknote is a sentinel, not evidence of broad superiority.
statistics.claims: Intervals and exploratory p-values do not override source, data, policy, baseline or evaluator-admission blockers. Keep unsupported/failed outcomes and negative results. Per-task rankings, guards, size and profiling results remain descriptive. No automatic engine promotion.

measured_compute.allocation: 10 or 30 measured training seconds per benchmark, independently; no transfer of unused allowance across tasks; maximum 256 total proposals and 1500 seconds/run.
measured_compute.semantics: A common training-time ceiling is not proof of equal consumed compute. Report actual training seconds, updates, processed examples/tokens, parameter counts, inherited ancestral work, started/failed fits and proposal-cap saturation. No FLOP-equivalence claim across backends.
measured_compute.completion: Select only candidates whose evaluations finish within that task budget; record start/end and score-availability boundaries. No overshooting candidate or later refit may supply a cutoff winner. Use best completed checkpoint according to a predeclared versioned contract. Distinguish planned budget censoring from genuine worker failure. Cells with no available outcome stay missing.
measured_compute.proposal_saturation: If 256 proposals are exhausted before the time ceiling, label the arm proposal-cap-limited; do not call it equal-consumed-work. Pilot must establish usable outcome/baseline coverage at both predeclared caps. If it cannot, stop C and issue a new pre-results protocol rather than silently change the caps.
measured_compute.export_gate: Current complete fixed-proposal validators require all declared evaluations. A time-limited result must have its own versioned budget/termination/export semantics and validation; never force it through by suppressing partial-run errors.

priority: Primordia time outside measured fit training
profiling.acceptance: Use disjoint top-level timers with documented nesting; reconcile totals with active invocation time and record unaccounted remainder. Synchronize asynchronous backend work at defined boundaries. Profile only Q seeds. Measure overhead in paired profiled/unprofiled qualification before interpreting timing; instrumentation must not change random streams, fit counts or winners.
profiling.budget: Q-core configurations provide unprofiled anchors. Additional instrumented repeats are outside the 840-run scientific matrix and must be counted as qualification overhead, with a separate cap of 20 runs / 3840 proposal attempts.

generalization.constraints: Existing breadth pack is experimental and not admitted as full-fidelity local-safe. Gate qualification, native replay, baseline adequacy and causal input construction before D. Freeze bytes/splits before execution. Aesop source must match its declared SHA; never accept a changed upstream file silently.
generalization.heldout: All training stages use declared training/validation data only. The final 15% of real text remains untouched. Add a separate frozen-winner protected-test evaluator before any test claim; it must prohibit policy/checkpoint selection after test access. No such test evaluator is currently prepared or authorized to read the protected split. Delayed-copy currently has train/validation only, so do not invent a protected-test result.
generalization.scope: Fresh seeds and a second corpus test robustness within these tasks; they do not establish general real-world architecture superiority or transfer.

launch_gates: Planning only: explicit launch instruction required. No fit, dataset preparation, scheduler installation, or protected-test access is performed by the generator.

Review and merge infrastructure changes before creating one clean, immutable execution producer; freeze environment, all configs, pool, data and host hashes. Numerical policies must match the declared reference or be a separately declared intervention.

Graceful stop/resume must be qualified: a requested pause finishes a bounded active fit, commits its outcome and closes the invocation clock at a safe boundary; restarts preserve remaining budgets and completed outcomes. Hard-killed unresolved fits remain visible and cannot receive fabricated clocks. Contenders must finish a bounded slot or use an explicitly qualified resume contract.
Validate source-bound profiling and callback/timestamp semantics without altering search RNG. Do not enable intrusive profilers on confirmation runs.
Q-breadth must pass before any breadth confirmation. Baseline adequacy requires more than schema validation or a model name being present.
C requires measured-training-budget execution and export support for every system; normal --timeout and proposal counts are not substitutes.

A policy-aware arm analysis must bind exact config hashes. Existing cohort-report only distinguishes engine/budget arms, so same-engine/same-budget variants need an explicit additive analysis request schema or a separately validated descriptive analyzer.
B/C/D selected-bundle rows are conditional until the nomination receipt is frozen; no fallback auto-execution as reference.

cost.interpretation: 840 x 1500s is an upper bound for run invocations only, not an ETA or a spending authorization; validation/replay/preparation add overhead. Actual compute-mode proposals can be below their ceiling.
cost.reference_estimate: Using the last observed current-policy core means and historical Contenders timings, unprofiled Q-core + A + B are roughly 26 hours before validation. This is only a planning reference: ablations, instrumentation, host load and dependencies can change it. Breadth and compute-mode durations remain unqualified; estimate them only from Q.

recovery: Never rerun successful slots for a better score. Keep source/config/seed identity and immutable journals. Missing or failed required runs leave their stage incomplete. Any replacement of an interrupted slot must receive a new explicit amendment with all previous work/cost retained; the historical 55+9 exception is not standing permission for undisclosed restarts.
deliverables: per-seed paired quality and resource tables
breadth report separating real text and synthetic memory
complete failure/restart accounting and replay receipts
